templates.name: Resize to 9:16 (1080×1920) — crop/reframe (social vertical)
templates.prompt:
You are resizing and reframing the provided content for a vertical social frame.

Target: {{TARGET_W}}×{{TARGET_H}} (aspect {{TARGET_ASPECT}}).

Rules:
- Preserve all important details and the original intent.
- Prefer reframing (crop/scale) over inventing new content.
- You MAY rotate slightly and correct perspective if it helps composition and keeps lines natural.
- Do NOT add text, watermarks, stickers, or platform UI.
- Keep colors and style consistent with the source ({{STYLE_HINT}}).
- Subject priority: {{SUBJECT_HINT}}

Output should look like the same shot, just reframed for {{TARGET_ASPECT}}.

templates.name: Resize to 9:16 (1080×1920) — preserve edges (extend background)
templates.prompt:
Reframe the content to a vertical social format without losing important edge details.

Target: {{TARGET_W}}×{{TARGET_H}} ({{TARGET_ASPECT}}).

Guidance:
- Preserve the main subject and all meaningful details.
- If simple crop would cut off important content, use content-aware extension (outpaint) to add realistic continuation of background/scene.
- You MAY rotate slightly and adjust perspective to make the scene fit naturally.
- Do NOT introduce new objects, logos, text, or UI.
- Keep lighting, grain, and color consistent ({{STYLE_HINT}}).
- Subject priority: {{SUBJECT_HINT}}

Result must feel like the original scene expanded/reframed, not redesigned.

templates.name: Resize to 16:9 (1920×1080) — crop/reframe (YouTube landscape)
templates.prompt:
Reframe the provided content into a clean 16:9 landscape master.

Target: {{TARGET_W}}×{{TARGET_H}} ({{TARGET_ASPECT}}).

Rules:
- Preserve details, identities, and the core scene.
- Prefer reframing via crop/scale; avoid adding new elements.
- You MAY rotate slightly and correct perspective to keep horizons/verticals natural.
- Do NOT add captions, logos, or watermarks.
- Maintain the original look/grade ({{STYLE_HINT}}).
- Subject priority: {{SUBJECT_HINT}}

Return a natural-looking 16:9 composition.

templates.name: Resize to 16:9 (1920×1080) — portrait→landscape (extend sides)
templates.prompt:
Convert the content to a 16:9 landscape frame while preserving the full subject. This often requires extending the scene to the left/right.

Target: {{TARGET_W}}×{{TARGET_H}} ({{TARGET_ASPECT}}).

Instructions:
- Do not crop away important parts of the subject.
- Use realistic content-aware extension to create missing background/scene.
- You MAY rotate and adjust perspective if needed to keep composition natural.
- Preserve lighting/color/style ({{STYLE_HINT}}).
- Do NOT add new objects, text, logos, or UI.
- Subject priority: {{SUBJECT_HINT}}

Result should look like the same moment, naturally widened to 16:9.

templates.name: UI/Screenshot → 9:16 (1080×1920) — keep text sharp
templates.prompt:
Reframe this UI/screenshot for a vertical 9:16 frame.

Target: {{TARGET_W}}×{{TARGET_H}} ({{TARGET_ASPECT}}).

Strict rules for UI:
- Preserve exact text, icons, and UI layout; do not hallucinate new buttons or labels.
- Keep text crisp and readable; avoid heavy blur or painterly artifacts.
- If you must extend background, extend only neutral areas (solid/gradient) and do not invent UI components.
- You MAY correct perspective/rotation so the UI is perfectly rectangular.
- No added watermarks or platform UI.
- Priority: {{SUBJECT_HINT}}

templates.name: Product photo → 1:1 (1080×1080) — clean studio framing
templates.prompt:
Reframe this product shot into a clean square composition.

Target: {{TARGET_W}}×{{TARGET_H}} ({{TARGET_ASPECT}}).

Rules:
- Keep product shape and branding accurate; no logo changes.
- Preserve fine details, edges, and materials.
- If needed, extend background to keep the full product in frame.
- You MAY correct perspective to make verticals straight and the product centered.
- Keep background simple and clean; do not add props.
- No text, no watermarks.
- Style: {{STYLE_HINT}}
- Priority: {{SUBJECT_HINT}}
